title: Union with Christ in Salvation
definition: Union with Christ in Salvation is the believer's spiritual connection to Jesus by which His life, death, resurrection, righteousness, and inheritance become theirs by grace.
summary: Union with Christ in Salvation teaches that every saving blessing comes because believers are joined to Jesus.
christFocus: Jesus is not only the giver of salvation but the living Savior to whom believers are joined forever.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Union with Christ is the living connection behind justification, sanctification, adoption, resurrection hope, and perseverance. The believer does not receive salvation as a package detached from Christ; he receives all things in Him. This doctrine holds the benefits of salvation together around the Savior Himself.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because Christians can separate doctrine from communion with Christ. Union reminds the Church that salvation is personal participation in the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus. It gives depth to identity: what is true of Christ's saving work becomes truly applied to those who belong to Him.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Learn to say, 'in Christ,' with worship and understanding. Face sin, suffering, and fear from your union with the risen Lord. Let every doctrine of salvation lead you back to fellowship with Him.
